Title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
Core_Methodology: Standard Federated Averaging (FedAvg) using weighted sample counts
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Assumes benign participants; highly vulnerable to model poisoning, free-riding, and Byzantine updates
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Provides baseline aggregation and benchmarks vulnerabilities under VANET adversarial conditions

Title: Machine Learning with Adversaries: Byzantine Tolerant Gradient Descent
Core_Methodology: Krum aggregation selecting Euclidean nearest vectors
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: High computational complexity O(n^2*d); rejects honest non-IID updates with legitimate gradient variance
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Combines update distance with longitudinal behavioral evidence to avoid rejecting honest non-IID vehicular agents

Title: Byzantine-Robust Distributed Learning: Towards Optimal Statistical Rates
Core_Methodology: Coordinate-wise Median and Trimmed Mean robust aggregation
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Statistically robust only under coordinate independence; vulnerable to subtle sign-flip and colluding shifts
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Incorporates cosine direction alignment and behavioral task-completion trust alongside coordinate outlier checks

Title: Trust-Aware Task Offloading and Resource Allocation in Vehicular Edge Computing
Core_Methodology: Evaluates behavioral trust (latency, completion rate) for node selection
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Does not address federated learning security; model poisoning at the policy level is neglected
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Unifies behavioral execution trust with model-update parameter trust in a closed-loop VEC pipeline

Title: Secure and Efficient Federated Learning for Vehicular Edge Computing
Core_Methodology: Blockchain-assisted reputation and verification for FL in vehicular networks
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Excessive latency overhead of blockchain consensus; does not model RL offloading dynamics or TraCI physics
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Lightweight Bayesian Beta trust and parameter distance checks executable in sub-second vehicular time scales

Title: How To Backdoor Federated Learning
Core_Methodology: Constrained model replacement attacks and targeted parameter poisoning
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Evaluates image classification tasks; ignores vehicular task scheduling, latency deadlines, and energy trade-offs
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Benchmarks parameter poisoning directly against DQN vehicular task scheduling and deadline satisfaction

Title: Federated Learning in Mobile Edge Networks: A Comprehensive Survey
Core_Methodology: Comprehensive taxonomy of FL resource allocation and incentive mechanisms
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Highlights need for joint trust-mobility-federation co-design under high-velocity dynamics
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Directly implements joint co-design combining SUMO microscopic car-following with trust-aware federated DQN

Title: Vehicular Edge Computing: Architecture Resource Allocation and Applications
Core_Methodology: Comprehensive VEC architecture covering V2I/V2V communication delays and MEC queues
Key_Limitations_or_Gap: Heuristic and game-theoretic scheduling without federated reinforcement learning defense
TAR_FRL_VEC_Contribution: Integrates realistic queue-aware V2I/V2V channel physics with robust multi-agent federated DQN offloading
